plugins.name: redis
plugins.description: Redis. Provision with flynn resource:add redis.

plugins.name: postgres
plugins.description: Tenant Postgres. One isolated instance per resource. Provision with flynn resource:add postgres. Not the platform appliance.

plugins.name: mariadb
plugins.description: MariaDB 10.11 (MySQL-compatible). Install as mariadb or mysql; provision with flynn resource:add mysql.

plugins.name: mongodb
plugins.description: MongoDB 7.0 replica set. Provision with flynn resource:add mongodb.

plugins.name: kafka
plugins.description: Apache Kafka 3.9 (KRaft). Provision with flynn resource:add kafka.

plugins.name: clickhouse
plugins.description: ClickHouse analytics database. Provision with flynn resource:add clickhouse.

plugins.name: www
plugins.description: Public cluster homepage on the apex and www hostnames.

plugins.name: otel
plugins.description: Forward cluster metrics to an OpenTelemetry collector (OTLP/HTTP).

plugins.name: letsencrypt
plugins.description: Let's Encrypt / ACME certificates. Enable HTTPS with flynn letsencrypt:enable <hostname>.

plugins.name: scheduler
plugins.description: Cron and interval jobs for apps. Manage with flynn scheduler.

plugins.name: autoscale
plugins.description: Scale web dynos when router HTTP response time p95 stays high. Manage with flynn autoscale.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub App deploys. Connect a repo with flynn github:connect after flynn-host plugin:install github.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: Environments and artifact promotion. Group apps with flynn pipeline after flynn-host plugin:install pipeline.

plugins.name: enterprise
plugins.description: SSO, audit, and granular RBAC. Unlock custom roles with flynn-host plugin:install enterprise.

private_plugins.name: billing
private_plugins.description: Hosted Stripe billing, plans, dyno metering, and feature paywalls. Not installable with plugin:install billing; company-operated clusters only.
